summary: Today continued with infrastructure work and automation. I finished setting up the Fastwood Forestry system for now, completing the current wood production chain. The system should provide enough logs for the base without relying on manual tree cutting.

With wood supply stabilized, I moved on to building a small logistics mall. The mall now produces several essential construction items automatically, including transport belts, underground belts, pipes, underground pipes, and mechanical inserters.
Having these items crafted automatically should make future construction and expansion significantly easier.
I also began preparing the layout for automated science production. The blueprint for planter boxes and copper wire production has been placed, as both are required components for the science chain.

The blueprint itself is not fully build and connected yet, but I already crafted most of the required buildings. If everything goes according to plan, automated science production should be finished tomorrow.
Aside from the construction work, the day was relatively quiet. I didn't leave the perimeter of the base at all today and focused entirely on internal development.
Defense remains an ongoing maintenance task. Several turrets and wall segments along the perimeter were destroyed during attacks and had to be replaced once again.

status.resource: Wood production chain operational with Fastwood Forestry.
status.power: 16 MW turbine array continuing to support base operations.
status.production: Logistics mall producing belts, pipes, and inserters.
status.defense: Perimeter holding with routine turret and wall repairs.
